claim_tested: AMD2 carries no PTS2, MTS, signal peptide, TM segment, NLS, myristoylation or CAAX signal
key_finding: 9 of 10 signal classes absent; only the permissive PTS1 -SKI matches
context: S. cerevisiae P22580, 549 aa, regex and hydropathy scan
confidence_limits: High for absence calls. Rule-based scans, not trained predictors (TargetP, DeepLoc, SignalP not callable here)

claim_tested: AMD2 is soluble, and the FAAH membrane localization does not carry over
confidence_limits: High. Single borderline peak is internal and matches a characterised cytosolic amidase

claim_tested: The -SKI terminus is not under purifying selection
key_finding: 19 Saccharomycetaceae homologs give 13 distinct C-terminal tripeptides; selection ratio 0.87 vs peroxisomal median 1.27 and cytosolic median 0.90 (MWU p=0.027). S. arboricola -GKI and S. mikatae -GNI break PTS1 outright
confidence_limits: Moderate-high. Small benchmark panel; 3 controls dropped for lack of taxon-restricted homologs

claim_tested: A permissive PTS1 is weak evidence for peroxisomal localization
key_finding: PPV of permissive PTS1 for GO:0005777 = 7.1% vs 60.0% for strict PTS1. The only other reviewed yeast -SKI proteins, RLM1 and NSA1, are nuclear/nucleolar
confidence_limits: High for the frequency statistic. PPV depends on current GO completeness

citation: This work (fungal family scan, Pfam PF01425)
claim_tested: No fungal amidase-signature lineage uses a peroxisomal or membrane targeting signal
key_finding: 0 of 12 lineages (61 proteins) have a PTS1 or PTS2; no TM segment except one marginal 1,819-aa homolog
context: Fungal PF01425 proteins, Smith-Waterman ranked against AMD2
confidence_limits: Moderate-high. Family breadth means some members are distant from AMD2

claim_tested: AMD2's C-terminus is not presented the way a functional PTS1 must be
key_finding: Dodecamer VCKFASWLFSKI, positions -12..-4 GRAVY +1.37 with 3 aromatics, z=+2.32; 0 of 18 bona fide yeast PTS1 proteins reach it. Last-10 pLDDT 93.5; neighbour counts 88/115/118 vs MDH3 49/49/109
confidence_limits: Moderate. Predicted model, not experimental. Honest negative: within 465 permissive-PTS1 proteins this metric does not separate peroxisomal from non-peroxisomal (MWU p=0.577)

claim_tested: A hydrophobic residue before the PTS1 tripeptide could make AMD2's -FSKI a real Pex9 signal
key_finding: Rule is real for Pex9-vs-Pex5 cargo choice, but proteome-wide it is not diagnostic: hydrophobic -4 in 33.6% of all yeast proteins; Fisher OR 0.60, p=0.439; adding it drops PPV from 7.1% to 2.3%
context: S. cerevisiae screens and structural modelling (paper); this work for the proteome test
confidence_limits: High. The published rule discriminates among proteins already known to be peroxisomal, not peroxisomal from cytosolic

claim_tested: PTS1 recognition requires more than the terminal tripeptide
key_finding: PTS1 is recognised as a C-terminal dodecamer with context requirements

claim_tested: PTS1 tripeptide space is permissive and context-dependent
key_finding: Accessory residues upstream modulate import; tripeptide alone is insufficient
confidence_limits: Review-level, used as methodology justification only

claim_tested: Would a genome-wide ortholog-expansion PTS1 screen flag AMD2
key_finding: Screen recovered Pxp1 (Yel020c) and Pxp2 (Yjr111c) as new peroxisomal matrix proteins; AMD2 not reported
context: S. cerevisiae genome-wide in silico screen plus validation
confidence_limits: Moderate. Absence from a reported list is not proof of testing and rejection

claim_tested: Does AMD2 colocalise with peroxisomes under oleate induction
key_finding: High-content imaging of most of the proteome in oleate identified new peroxisome-colocalising proteins and Pex9; AMD2 not reported
context: S. cerevisiae, oleate vs glucose, high-content microscopy
confidence_limits: Moderate. Per-ORF coverage not stated in the abstract

claim_tested: Does AMD2 interact with peroxisomal import receptors
key_finding: 77 interaction records, 0 with PEX1/5/6/7/8/9/13/14. Only physical protein hit is an AMD2-AMD2 two-hybrid self-interaction
context: High-throughput yeast two-hybrid and affinity capture
confidence_limits: Moderate. Pex5 cargo interactions are transient and often missed by two-hybrid

claim_tested: Do fungal amidase-signature proteins with predicted signals actually get exported
key_finding: Ami1p of bottom-fermenting yeast has a predicted signal sequence by hydropathy yet stays intracellular. AMI1 is absent from S. cerevisiae S288C and is not an AMD2 ortholog
context: Bottom-fermenting brewing yeast, chromosomes XIII and X
confidence_limits: Indirect. Cannot be cited as evidence about AMD2 itself; included to prevent paralog confusion

claim_tested: Is AMD2 the yeast N-acylethanolamine amidase, by analogy to FAAH
key_finding: Yeast N-palmitoylethanolamine inactivation maps to YJU3, not AMD2
confidence_limits: Removes a functional analogy that would have implied FAAH-like membrane association

claim_tested: What is the current curated localization of AMD2
key_finding: GO evidence code ND on all three aspects; no experimental localization on record
confidence_limits: Database-level. Confirms the annotation vacuum this hypothesis addresses
